Class DBEngineSQLServer

java.lang.Object
msfx.lib.db.DBEngine
msfx.lib.db.adapters.DBEngineSQLServer
public class DBEngineSQLServer extends DBEngine
SQL Server adapter, for the Microsoft JDBC driver (mssql-jdbc).

The connection string is the part of the URL after "jdbc:sqlserver://", for instance "host:1433;databaseName=name".

Type mappings: BOOLEAN as VARCHAR(1), DECIMAL as NUMERIC(p,s), DOUBLE as FLOAT(53), LONG as BIGINT, INTEGER as INT, DATE as DATE, TIME as TIME(7), DATETIME as DATETIME2(7), STRING as NVARCHAR(n) or NVARCHAR(MAX), BINARY as VARBINARY(n) or VARBINARY(MAX), and OBJECT as NVARCHAR(MAX). A length of -1, or greater than the limit of the variable type, maps to the MAX variant.

Author:
Miquel Sas
